item.title: Sech’s ‘SECHO GANG’ Album & More: Vote for the Best New Latin Music Release This Week
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to this week's Latin music update. If you're a fan of new and exciting Latin tunes, you're in the right place. Let's dive into the latest releases and trends on Billboard's New Music Latin poll."
[Short music transition]
Host: "This week, we see some amazing new albums from top artists like Maluma, Julieta Venegas, and Gera MX. But one release that's catching our attention is Sech's sixth studio album, SECHO GANG. This 13-track set features collaborations with Ryan Castro, Jay Wheeler, and Kris R., and showcases a more healed and energized Sech."
[Short clip of Sech's music plays]
Host: "Sech himself says this album is special, made for his day one fans who've been with him from the start. He's poured his heart and love into every song, and we can't wait to hear what you think."
[Short music transition]
Host: "Other notable releases this week come from Becky G, Mon Laferte, and Lenny Tavárez. And if you're wondering what's currently topping the charts, Sebastian Yatra and Augusto Alonso's 'Lo Que Me Pasa Con Vos' is leading the pack with over 98% of the vote."
[Outro music starts playing]
Host: "So, which release is your favorite? Cast your vote in Billboard's New Music Latin poll, and tune in next week to see the results. The poll closes on Monday, May 18, at 11 a.m. ET. Thanks for joining us, and we'll catch you on the next beat."
[Outro music continues to play until the end]
